name: wabim-bridges
description: Sistema de Evaluación del Estado de Puentes mediante Inspección Visual (metodología WABIM + Manual INVÍAS).

scripts.dev: npm run build:css && tsx watch src/server/server.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:css && tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/db && cp src/db/schema.sql dist/db/schema.sql
scripts.build:offline: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p public/wabim public/vendor && cp dist/wabim/catalog.js dist/wabim/catalog.js.map dist/wabim/engine.js dist/wabim/engine.js.map dist/wabim/types.js dist/wabim/types.js.map public/wabim/ && cp src/db/schema.sql public/db-schema.sql && cp node_modules/pdf-lib/dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js node_modules/sql.js/dist/sql-wasm.js node_modules/sql.js/dist/sql-wasm.wasm public/vendor/ && esbuild src/offline-entry.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=public/vendor/capacitor-bundle.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:css && npm run build:offline && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
